backup.production_rule: Replaces due_guest_messages_v1 in place (same signature, same service_role-only grant) and inserts three app_settings rows (review links; on conflict do nothing). No table or column changes. Take a fresh backup if this one is more than an hour old at apply time.

forward_verification.name: the_body_is_the_reviewed_body
forward_verification.query: select md5(prosrc) = '4513e1e984dc255f2fbf88764184fe89' from pg_proc where oid = 'public.due_guest_messages_v1(timestamptz)'::regprocedure

forward_verification.name: the_review_links_exist
forward_verification.query: select (select value #>> '{}' from public.app_settings where key = 'review_airbnb_url') = 'https://airbnb.com/h/cascadesgsc' and (select count(*) from public.app_settings where key in ('review_facebook_url','review_google_url')) = 2
